title: Avaada Electro IPO
summary: Avaada Electro IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹7,600 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Avaada Electro IPO has a total issue size of ₹7,600 Crores Approx. and will be listed on BSE and NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Avaada Electro financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Avaada Electro Private Limited was incorporated in the month of April 2021. It belongs to the renewable energy industry and deals with the manufacture of solar cells and solar photovoltaic (PV) modules. As of the day of the Updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus-I, it has 8.50 GW of operational manufacturing capacity for solar modules and 3.00 GW of operational manufacturing capacity for TOPCon solar cells, which makes it one of the top 10 manufacturers of vertically integrated solar PV in India according to the mentioned CRISIL Report. · · The Company maintains manufacturing plants at Dadri, Uttar Pradesh and Nagpur, Maharashtra, that produce bifacial glass-to-glass N-type TOPCon solar modules. · · As of March 31, 2026, the Company employs 1,659 full-time employees. It is well positioned to enter into the increasing solar PV market owing to its focus on advanced technology, scale, cost-efficient operations and vertical integration.
Vineet Mittal, Sindoor Vineet Mittal, Avaada Ventures Pvt.Ltd. are the company's promoters of Avaada Electro.
